answer_2.quote: We use BLIP-2 as the VQA model to measure the faithfulness of the generation model... we use VILA to measure the aesthetics measurement score... We also use ImageReward, an off-the-shelf human preference model, to evaluate generated images.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study with over 1000 images ... each image is rated by 3 human raters. ... we ask approximately 8 fine-grained questions for each of 1060 images to external raters.
answer_4.guideline: Raters answer fine-grained yes/no questions about each image, covering categories such as entity, attribute, relation, and global aspects.
